# Agent Development Kit (ADK)

## Overview

ADK is a skills-first repository for coding agents. It provides self-contained `adk-*` skills, canonical agent personas for parallel subagent work, runtime-specific custom agent sources for Claude/Cursor/Codex, lifecycle hooks, MCP configs, and composable workflows.

## Install

- `npx skills add sujeet-pro/agents-devkit --all`
- `git clone https://github.com/sujeet-pro/agents-devkit.git ~/.agents-devkit`
- `cd ~/.agents-devkit && ./scripts/install.sh --agents claude,cursor,codex --global`

## Key Skills

- `adk-brainstorm`
- `adk-plan`
- `adk-research`
- `adk-build`
- `adk-refactor`
- `adk-migrate`
- `adk-review-pr`
- `adk-review-local-changes`
- `adk-review-docs`
- `adk-write-docs`
- `adk-spec`
- `adk-audit-repo`
- `adk-audit-site`
- `adk-test`
- `adk-design`
- `adk-diagram`
- `adk-chart`
- `adk-commit`

## Architecture

- Skills are the primary task invocation surface.
- Canonical agent personas live in `agent-personas/adk-*/AGENT.md`.
- Runtime-specific custom agent sources live in `agents-claude/`, `agents-cursor/`, and `agents-codex/`.
- Runtime-specific hooks live in `hooks/settings.json`, `hooks/hooks-cursor/hooks.json`, and `hooks/hooks-codex/hooks.json`.
- Shared guidance lives in `ai-guidelines/`.

## File Structure

- `skills/`: published installable skills
- `agent-personas/`: canonical reusable agent personas
- `agents-claude/`, `agents-cursor/`, `agents-codex/`: generated runtime-specific agent sources
- `hooks/`: generated runtime-specific lifecycle hook sources
- `mcp-config/`: MCP server configurations
- `workflows/`: composable multi-skill pipelines
- `docs/`: documentation site
- `skills-manifest.json`: generated public skill index
